title: Announcing The Last Lab: GRaD Launch
date: Saturday, October 25, 2025 • 1:00–5:00 PM ET • FS2-107Q + Livestream
description: Celebrate our October Graphic Design Bachelor’s graduate, Caleb Richardson! An afternoon of games, prizes, design presentations, networking, and community.
moreInfo:
Hosted by Full Sail’s graduating Graphic Design students and faculty. This campus event runs alongside a livestream for online students. Expect quick design talks, demos, casual networking, and prizes throughout the afternoon.

Professionalism Credit (GPS):
Students attending can earn GPS credit through the Count Me In and Check-In Code options on Full Sail One. No RSVP or portfolio submission is required—just participation.

title: Feedback Jam — Alumni Portfolio Critique
date: Saturday, October 25, 2025 • During The Last Lab • FS2-107Q + Livestream
description: On-campus critique session for portfolio pieces, projects, and works-in-progress—guided by DAD/GRD alumni.
moreInfo:
Leads:
• Lucia Aveitua — Multimedia Designer, Automation Builder, Growth Partner at Upward Seven
• Kathleen Reyes — Senior Art Director, Marriott Vacations Worldwide; President, AIGA Orlando
• Bart Pryor — Multimedia Designer, Rocket Chimp Marketing & Advertising

Who Should Attend:
• Graphic Design students seeking actionable, in-person feedback
• Anyone curious about the critique process and industry expectations

How It Works (On Campus):
• Attend during The Last Lab event; feedback will be provided throughout the session—no reserved time slots
• Bring 1–2 pieces (portfolio, poster, motion, etc.) and participate in the open critique

Professionalism Credit (GPS):
Students can earn GPS credit through the Count Me In and Check-In Code options on Full Sail One.

Livestream (View-Only):
Remote students may watch select sessions. **No remote portfolio reviews for this event.**
